capabilities: detect new binary files in the vault
create Markdown metadata files for binary files
format metadata file names and contents with template syntax
use Templater to generate metadata file contents
customize the location of metadata files
extras: Templater support requires installing and enabling the separate Templater plugin and turning on the 'Use Templater' setting.
problem: Binary files like PDFs and images can't be searched, tagged or linked directly, so they stay outside Obsidian's text-based workflows.

relations.evidence: You can also use Templater plugin to format your meta data files.

summary: Metadata generator that detects new binary files in the vault and creates companion Markdown files with templated metadata for them.
